title: Recipe Variant Preservation

steps.text: Brown the chicken and bacon, then pour in the stock.
Cover and bake for 50 minutes, finishing with the vanilla.

notes: Rest for ten minutes before serving.

variants.title: Richer version
variants.text: For a richer version, add 100 ml cream with the stock.

variants.title: Vegetarian version
variants.text: For a vegetarian version, omit the bacon and replace the chicken stock with vegetable stock.

variants.title: Individual pies
variants.text: For individual pies, divide among six ramekins and bake for 20 minutes instead.

variants.title: Chocolate-orange version
variants.text: For the chocolate-orange version, follow the chocolate variation above but replace the vanilla with orange zest.
Variation: a spoonful of mustard stirred through at the end sharpens it.
